newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia revises 1995/96 c/a deficit higher.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia revises 1995/96 c/a deficit higher.

text.p: The Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Wednesday it had revised upwards the current account deficit for 1995/96 to June 30 by A$966 million to A$20.93 billion from A$19.97 billion.
The bureau said the revisions primarily related to investment income credits.
"Revised survey data have resulted in lower estimates for the reinvested earnings attributable to Australian investors from their direct investment equity holdings abroad," it said.

It said these revisions were partly offset by a A$235 million downward revision of investment income debits, reflecting changes to the reinvested earnings of non-resident investors on their direct investments in Australia.
